JOB-2026-101.taskDescription: 10kW Solar PV Inverter & Array Annual Safety Inspection + Smoke Alarm Verification
JOB-2026-101.assetsIdentified: Rooftop PV array (32 panels), Fronius Inverter, Switchboard Sub-Distribution

steps.hazards: Fall from height, unstable ladder footing, slippery tiles
steps.controls: Ladder secured with bracket & tie-off strap. Fall arrest harness hitched to rated anchor point.

steps.hazards: Electric shock from DC string voltages (up to 600V DC), arc flash
steps.controls: Lockout/tagout on AC main breaker and DC isolators. Calibrated CAT IV multi-meter test for zero volts.

steps.hazards: Dust ingress, wasp nests, loose screw terminals
steps.controls: Insulated hand tools, torque screwdriver to manufacturer spec (2.5Nm).

isolationsAndPermits.item: AC Solar Supply Main Switch Lockout
